about.title: About Zeus Marine and Cargo Solutions
text: Zeus Marine and Cargo Solutions is an industry leader provider of marine surveying and cargo surveying, adjusters, and consulting services.
We are involved with all modes of transportation providing support and advice to a wide variety of clients in numerous industries around the world.

Zeus Marine and Cargo Solutions surveyors are seasoned marine and transportation professionals with long track records in the industry. Many of our surveyors have previously worked as sea Captains or Chief Engineers, in major consulting firms, in marine insurance, and other diverse leadership positions ashore like DPA and CSO.
